packageRules.description: Group same-major minor/patch bumps so routine updates land as one PR instead of one-per-package (what this repo had before - see closed PRs #58/#59/#62/#63).
Every major bump stays its own PR - each needs its own Docker-verified migration per this repo's upgrade process (docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md, CHANGELOG.md), never batched or auto-merged.
GitHub Actions pinned by commit SHA; keep them updated too but on their own schedule/grouping to not mix with npm deps.
